newsitem.title: UK: Simon up as report stokes bid talk.
newsitem.headline: Simon up as report stokes bid talk.

text.p: Shares in Simon Group Plc rose on Friday after a report in the Daily Mail said recent buying of the shares had sparked bid speculation around the engineering group, dealers said.
The paper said there was talk of a bid from mini-conglomerate Rutland Trust Plc, which owns the Thamesport container terminal.
The two announced in March that they were in informal talks relating the port-related activities of the two groups, but Rutland at that time said it had not made a takeover approach for Simon.
Simon shares were up 2p or 4.2 percent at 49 by 0800 GMT in volume of 206,485 shares. Rutland was down 1/4p at 57-1/2.
No-one at Simon or Rutland was immediately available for comment.
